facts.fact: iAfrica, on 2026-09-12, describes Egypt's National AI Strategy 2025-2030 as in force, with a target of 250 AI companies by 2030, and says the World Bank pledged support for the second national strategy (a donor pledge, not stated as public money); a closing line also calls it a 'draft AI strategy', which conflicts with the rest of the article.

note: Private AI factory launch and World Bank pledge give no body or public-funding fact for the strategy.
